targets.review_note: Earlier groups should contain the larger probabilities by an exchange argument, so sort descending. If a group ends at position i and starts after t, its contribution to the expectation numerator is i*(prefix[i]-prefix[t]). The exact-group partition recurrence is a lower envelope of lines with decreasing slopes -prefix[t], queried at increasing i. A monotone convex hull gives O(w*n) time using exact integer comparisons; divide by total weight only when formatting four decimals.

targets.review_note: Preserve each input element while it shares no prime with the chosen prefix. At the first conflict choose the smallest larger integer with no used prime factor, which is forced by lexicographic minimality. Once greater, fill the suffix with the smallest unused primes: every admissible composite has a smaller admissible prime divisor. Before the first increase, used primes are at most100000; together with at most100000 suffix primes the two-million sieve covers all required choices. Multiple marking implements exact pairwise coprimality, not just adjacency checks.
